subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He ______ a clever plan to safeguard his secret.
solution:
The correct answer is option ), i.e., 'devised.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 created
 to make something new, or invent something. (कुछ नया करना, या कुछ आविष्कार करना)
 
 

 devised
 to invent a plan, system, object, etc., usually using your intelligence or imagination. (आमतौर पर अपनी बुद्धि या कल्पना का उपयोग करके एक योजना, प्रणाली, वस्तु आदि का आविष्कार करना)
 
 

 planned
 a set of decisions about how to do something in the future. (भविष्य में कुछ करने के तरीके के बारे में निर्णयों का एक समूह)
 
 

 imagined
 to form or have a mental picture or idea of something. (किसी चीज का मानसिक चित्र या विचार बनाना या बनाना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that to keep his secret private; he invented a brilliant solution.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "devised."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option .

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *The scientists **devised** a new way to treat cancer​.*
 
 

 

Complete Sentence:__ *He __devised__ a clever plan to safeguard his secret.*
